item.title: AIM movers: Vast Resources returns from suspension and Empire Metals mineral resource estimate upgrade
item.summary: Vast Resources (LON: VAST) shares have returned from suspension following the completion of the reverse takeover of Gulf International Minerals. The sellers own 80.2% of the enlarged company. This brings a 49% interest in the Aprelevka joint venture, which has four mining licences in the Tien Shan gold belt.
